title: Ingrid tests the sheep tissue (paraphrase D)
topic: A laboratory team investigates a prion sample: Ingrid receives a tissue sample with misfolded prions, the microscope shows fibrils that form a plaque, a chaperone protein dissolves an aggregate, a colleague disagrees with the result, and a second test confirms the prion

tail_E: Ingrid concludes that the sheep suffered from a fatal prion
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'disease' completes 'the sheep suffered from a fatal prion' after ten units about misfolded prions, fibrils and a plaque in sheep tissue ('prion disease' is the standard collocation of the domain). The word and its German equivalents (Krankheit / Erkrankung / Leiden) occur nowhere in the units or the tail, and the competitors 'illness' and 'infection' are absent as well. ' disease' is a single Pythia token (id 2728); Pythia-160m ranks it first after the all-English context (p ~ 0.38, next candidate 'infection' ~ 0.17; pilot check for tail selection only, not a result).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase D of family F19 (prion sample in the laboratory, Ingrid)
notes: Formulation D, domain protein_misfolding: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten F19A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Ingrid). Replacements include Ingrid receives a tissue sample from the clinic/a tissue sample reaches Ingrid from the clinic (erhält/erreicht; the sample is the subject, Ingrid the object), contains misfolded prions/includes misfolded prions (enthält/umfasst), puts the sample under the microscope/studies the sample under the microscope (legt/studiert), shows long fibrils/exposes long fibrils (zeigt/offenbart), form a dense plaque between the cells/gather into a dense plaque between cells (bilden/sammeln sich zu), mixes a chaperone protein into the sample/treats the sample with a chaperone protein (mischt ... in die Probe/versetzt die Probe mit), dissolves a small aggregate within an hour/splits a small aggregate within one hour (löst/spaltet), a colleague disagrees with the result at the meeting/doubts the finding at the lab meeting (widerspricht dem Ergebnis/zweifelt am Befund), repeats the test with a fresh sample/undertakes a further test with a new sample (wiederholt den Test/unternimmt einen weiteren Versuch; a segment-final 'Test' would be read as the English lexicon word by lsne.lang_id in the mixed variants), the second test confirms the prion/the second run confirms the prion (Test/Durchlauf). Domain vocabulary is kept in both languages: Prionen, fehlgefaltet, Fibrillen, Plaque, Chaperonprotein (closed compound, since lsne.lang_id splits 'Chaperon-Protein' at the hyphen and would read 'Protein' as English), Aggregat. 'erreicht', 'umfasst', 'studiert', 'offenbart', 'versetzt', 'spaltet', 'unternimmt' and 'bestätigt' are inseparable, 'sammeln sich' is reflexive; no separable verbs ('ankommen', 'hinzufügen', 'auseinandernehmen', 'nachweisen' avoided). The tail keeps the probe clause of A/B ('the sheep suffered from a fatal prion') on purpose, as formulation B does. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English. 'Ingrid' is labelled 'N' by lsne.lang_id in English context and as a German noun inside German segments (not in the lexicon's name list), neither of which counts as an error.
